thread:
sara: Heads-up: proposing a quiet window for Wellspring (Dedicated) migration — Tue 2026-04-07 02:00-05:00 UTC. Need approvals for KMS overlap, model/runtime pin, and rollback criteria. Summary below.

chris: SGTM on the window. Who's owning KMS check? also which model/runtime are we pinning to?

maria: I'll own KMS. We should pin runtime to release v2.14.1 and model to rdlw-7b-v1-q4a (verified perf on canary).

jesse_ops: Ops acked to standby for the window. Runbook highlights: pre-failure snapshot, drain 10m, traffic shift 5% -> 50% -> 100% in 10m increments. If error-rate spikes >1% for 5m revert.

ellen_pm: Added release notes to the ticket: "KV cache hotfix, batching improvements, and minor latency regression fix." Nothing user-facing except potential recovery speedups.

deploybot: [deploy-plan] Wellspring-dedicated -> plan-id: wb-20260407-01
- pinned: runtime=v2.14.1, model=rdlw-7b-v1-q4a
- nodes: 6 gpus (dedicated pool)
- prechecks: kms-rotation-ok, snapshot-ok, metrics-alerts-hooked
- rollback-hook: auto-failover-to: rdlw-7b-v1-q3 (previous), runtime=v2.13.9

sara: KMS check: maria, can you confirm there is no customer KMS rotation scheduled within +/-24h of window? Also any policy requiring HSM swap awareness?

maria: Confirmed: no customer-initiated rotation. Key policy note: HSM maintenance currently scheduled for 2026-04-09, so safe. :thumbsup:

chris: Performance guardrails proposed: p50 latency increase >20% sustained over 10m OR p95 increase >30% for 5m -> hit rollback gate. Also SLO error budget burn >15% in 30m -> rollback. Agree?

jesse_ops: Agree. Add health-check: KV cache miss-rate >12% for 10m triggers partial traffic hold and investigation. I'll add runbook snippet.

ellen_pm: One ask from CS: hold a 30m post-cutover observation window before notifying customer their traffic is fully on new slice. We'll schedule a quick customer check-in.

sara: Sounds good. Approvals: @chris, @ellen_pm, @maria, @jesse_ops — please respond with :thumbsup: to approve final go. If no objections by EOD today we'll pin and notify deploybot for scheduled run.

chris: :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup:

jesse_ops: :thumbsup:

ellen_pm: :thumbsup: adding note to release ticket about customer check-in.

deploybot: Scheduling done. job wb-20260407-01 queued. Prechecks will run 2026-04-07T01:30:00Z. Final notify will post here 30m before window.

sara: Thanks team — I'll keep this thread as the go/no-go channel during the window and paste post-mortem if anything unusual.

chris: ping if you want me on-call for rollback.

jesse_ops: I'll be on standby 01:45-06:00 UTC. Runbook excerpt: ```rollback steps:
1) pause traffic shift
2) revert model pointer to rdlw-7b-v1-q3
3) roll runtime to v2.13.9 if required
4) restart proxies and validate 200s on health endpoints
5) follow post-rollback telemetry runbook```

sara: Perfect. Thread pinned to ticket #WL-4021. Last update before window will be deploybot's precheck result.

deploybot: PRECHECK OK: kms:OK, snapshot:OK, metrics-hook:OK. Ready to proceed.
